STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_023232.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_023232.v · Open raw
module origen_023232 (
    input [31:0] DataIn,
    input [31:0] address,
    input rw,
    input mov,
    input [1:0] typeData,
    output reg [31:0] DataOut,
    output reg moc
);

    reg [7:0] mem [0:255];

    always @(rw or mov) begin
        moc = 0;
        if (rw == 1) begin // Read operation
            case (typeData)
                2'b00: begin // Byte access
                    DataOut = {24'b0, mem[address[7:0]]};
                end
                2'b01: begin // Halfword access
                    DataOut = {16'b0, mem[address[7:0]+1], mem[address[7:0]]};
                end
                2'b10: begin // Word access
                    DataOut = {mem[address[7:0]+3], mem[address[7:0]+2], mem[address[7:0]+1], mem[address[7:0]]};
                end
                default: DataOut = 32'b0;
            endcase
            moc = 1;
        end
        else if (rw == 0 && mov == 1) begin // Write operation
            case (typeData)
                2'b00: begin // Byte access
                    mem[address[7:0]] = DataIn[7:0];
                end
                2'b01: begin // Halfword access
                    mem[address[7:0]] = DataIn[7:0];
                    mem[address[7:0]+1] = DataIn[15:8];
                end
                2'b10: begin // Word access
                    mem[address[7:0]] = DataIn[7:0];
                    mem[address[7:0]+1] = DataIn[15:8];
                    mem[address[7:0]+2] = DataIn[23:16];
                    mem[address[7:0]+3] = DataIn[31:24];
                end
            endcase
            moc = 1;
        end
    end

endmodule
